title: Verbal nouns
summary: Use the infinitive with case endings (*yüzmeyi seviyorum*, *yüzmeye başladım*, *yüzmekten korkuyorum*), give an action its own doer with `-mA` and a possessive (*Gelmeni istiyorum*), make nouns in `-(y)Iş` (*yürüyüş*, *giriş*), and say **in order to** three ways.
canDo: Say what you like, hate, start, try and decide to do
Say what you want or expect someone else to do
Read signs and tickets: giriş, çıkış, uçuş, gidiş dönüş
Say why you went somewhere or did something
